description.narrative:
Project-level Impact:
Project Outcome: The Project will increase consumer access to (fortified) wheat products and therefore contribute to food security and nutrition in Sierra Leone where prevalence of undernutrition, stunting and wasting is high. Protein intake per capita and day is also low. IFC expects the Project will increase value addition and create direct and indirect jobs along the Projects supply chain.
Market Outcome: The Project will increase resilience in the market by building capacity in the Companys supply chain to withstand shocks and stresses related the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and climatic change affecting cereals production. This is expected to have significant impact as the Company is a major player in food distribution in the country.

The proposed investment is an up to US$12 million loan to Sierra Leone Flour Mill Limited (SLFM or the Company) guaranteed by BSB International Limited (BSB or the Guarantor, together with SLFM referred to as the Group) to support SLFMs US$19.2 million project for the expansion of its (i) milling capacity from 150 metric tons (MT) of wheat per day to 450 MT and (ii) storage capacity from 8,400 MT to 28,400 MT at its factory located in Cline Town, Freetown, Sierra Leone (the Project). The Project may be supported by the Canada-IFC Facility for Resilient Food Systems (Canada FRFS), subject to obtaining the necessary internal approvals, as described in the Blended Finance section.
